specific_objectives: 18.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to explain functioning of gear, their classification

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of gear diagrams from IB; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a gear train?
How does gear ratio affect output speed?
Why are reduction gears used in aircraft engines?

development.content:
Definition of reduction gear
Working principle of gear reduction
Input and output shaft relationship
Torque and speed transformation

Classification of reduction gears
Simple vs compound gear trains
Epicyclic gear systems
Helical and spur gear types

Efficiency considerations in gears
Heat generation and lubrication
Common failure modes
Maintenance implications

summary_questions: Explain how a reduction gear increases torque.
Differentiate between simple and compound gear trains.
List two common failure modes in reduction gears.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the application of reduction gears in the next lesson topic (LP 07 - Operation & functions of bearing) focusing on how bearing loads relate to gear output torque.
